Admin Dashboard loads with login and shows real orders with ASSIGNER LIVREUR button. Driver App in test mode shows online/offline toggle and real missions from Supabase.

context_for_next_testing_agent: ACTOOS ONE PWA delivery app. KDS Menu now has photo upload zone with Camera icon (URL field collapsed). Admin Dashboard uses MOCKED mockDrivers array for Livreurs tab but REAL Supabase data for Commandes and Inscriptions. Driver App shows real missions from orders table.

1_kds_menu_photo_upload_zone.details: KDS Menu add form shows photo upload zone with Camera icon and 'Prendre ou choisir une photo' text. File input accepts image/*. URL field is collapsed in <details> element with 'Ou entrer une URL d'image' summary. Max 5MB limit displayed.

2_admin_dashboard_login.details: Admin Dashboard loads at /admin with login form. Credentials contact@actoos.com / Salifkane&&7 work correctly. GOD MODE header displayed after login.

3_admin_commandes_tab_orders.details: Commandes tab shows real orders from Supabase. Order ACT-260507-4463 displayed with URGENT badge (1h d'attente), restaurant name (Maquis Chez Tanti), delivery address, price (1,700 FCFA), payment method (cash), and ASSIGNER LIVREUR button.

4_admin_livreurs_tab_drivers.details: Livreurs tab shows driver list with stats (3 Total, 2 En ligne, 1 En mission). Drivers: Amadou Diallo (Disponible), Moussa Keita (En mission), Ibrahim Traore (Hors ligne). NOTE: Driver list is MOCKED (mockDrivers array).

5_driver_app_test_mode_toggle.details: Driver App loads at /driver?test=true. Shows 'Hors ligne' status with 'Passer en ligne' button. Online toggle in header works correctly. Wallet stats displayed (Solde, Aujourd'hui, Livraisons).

6_driver_app_online_missions.details: When online, Driver App shows 'Missions disponibles' section with real missions from Supabase orders table. Mission card shows restaurant name, addresses, estimated earnings (+595 F), and ACCEPTER button.

7_driver_mission_details.details: Mission card displays: Restaurant (Maquis Chez Tanti), Restaurant address (Hamdallaye ACI 2000, Bamako), Delivery address (Bamako, Banconi - Près du marché, porte bleue), Estimated earnings (+595 F), Payment method badge (💵 Cash).
